head: e379c2749e0815538f23500ef5a3b2117569c0c6
title: Defer Worlds loading and avoid repeated Missions setup
body:
Depends on #1620

Opening Solo currently evaluates the Worlds menu code before it is needed, and Missions repeats catalogue initialization and current-mission identity work. Load Worlds on demand, initialize the Missions index once, and compute the current mission identity once per render while retaining stale-owner and validation checks. Update the generated FPV shell with the same canonical UI changes.

This draft is for source qualification. Keep it unmerged until the published Missions observation for #1620 has completed.

Validation:
- Independent source and admission review is complete. Latest main was merged normally; the complete resulting blob tree matches the reviewed union, including the independent Capture changes.
- Adds 14 Worlds-loading, two current-identity, and six constructor controls. These new controls have not executed yet; exact-head Source, Appearance, Industrial and Company checks are required.
- Production build, generated-shell, offline/CSP and shared-mode checks remain required. Removing three eager modules (51,265 source bytes) is a source-graph reduction, not a measured startup-time improvement.

Progress and remaining qualification are tracked in #1623. Physical iPhone/Steam Deck results remain outstanding.
